---
title: "Playa Norte or Cerro Alto: Which District to Buy In"
description: "A side by side comparison of Playa Norte and Cerro Alto for condo buyers on Isla Verde: prices, service charges, rental demand and the school run."
pubDate: 2026-03-05
author: Isla Verde Editorial
---

**Quick answer:** Playa Norte for rental income, Cerro Alto for living on the island year round.

## Price gap

The first 50 metres from the high tide line belong to the state and cannot be sold to anyone, and the next 150 metres may be leased for 30 years with a renewal right.

## What changed in 2026

The average price in Cerro Alto in 2026 was 1,100 CRC per sqm, up 2% on the year, according to the registry.

## Service charges

Coastal buildings pay for pool maintenance and salt corrosion, so their service charge runs at 3.2 CRC per sqm a month against 1.8 CRC in the hills. Every lease longer than three years must be registered at the land registry within 30 days of signing, or the lease cannot be enforced against a new owner of the land.
